MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB extensions fit my effort to keep desk peripherals accessible and cables organized, building on my previous USB extension purchase.",
    "The flash drive feels useful for moving files between my laptop and Raspberry Pi projects without requiring a specific hardware upgrade."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The internal SSDs, memory kit, and SATA cable assume an upgrade project and compatible hardware that my purchases do not establish.",
    "The RCA, DisplayPort, and DVI connections do not address an identified need in my setup; owning headphones and computer accessories does not mean I need these connections.",
    "Another HDMI cable offers little immediate benefit because I already bought one and have no current need for a longer cable."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in laptop and Raspberry Pi accessories seems to have been stretched into an interest in internal computer upgrades.",
    "My cable purchases seem to have been treated as interest in cables generally, although the connector, length, and specific task determine whether I need one."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point toward organizing, connecting, and maintaining an existing workspace, which makes practical peripheral accessories more relevant.",
    "A previous purchase can mean a need is already satisfied; I need a clear additional use before choosing a similar item again.",
    "Specialized parts need a matching device and an immediate purpose, while a five-pack needs a reason for using that many cables."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical electronics accessories but too often assumed that related hardware would serve a current need."
}
